items.full_text: One-click encrypted DNS (DoH/DoT/DoQ/DNSCrypt), GoodbyeDPI-based DPI bypass, a local HTTP/SOCKS proxy with TLS fragmentation, and domain rules for Windows. ~30 MB RAM in the tray, no telemetry, always restores your original DNS. For research and educational use.
